scoring_rules.r100: gold exact text, case/whitespace-insensitive. Engine: only status=answered replies count as answers; the whole response text is compared to gold. Reader7: the set of distinct answers from read7 (control 'reader7') or v6 read first then read7 (control 'reader7_cascade', the order in reader_v7.py __main__); empty set = unknown, more than one distinct answer = refused, one answer = compared to gold. Native outcomes are copied from native-observations.json.
scoring_rules.c16: entity: answer name equals expected.answer; count: answer equals expected.answer; decline_ambiguous and decline_empty: any non-answer counts as declined_expected, any single answer as answered_unexpected. Engine: status other than answered is a decline.

reader7.note: each question is read by both rd.read and rd.read7

category_note: Engine 'withheld' = status clarification or withheld (74 clarification, 32 withheld over the 116); Reader7 'unknown' = no reading produced an answer. Neither control produced a wrong answer except as listed under engine_nonmatching_answers.
